findings.passage: "Hoosiers shouldn't hesitate to reach out and ask for help or report an issue."
findings.note: In a caucus press release, DeVon is quoted urging voters to use the new state text hotline for election questions and problems. The release says he said voters can use it to report something suspicious at a polling site and to ask about election security. It does not mention ID or citizenship.

findings.passage: I recommend taking just a few minutes to check your voter registration and personal information at IndianaVoters.com.
findings.note: In a caucus press release, DeVon urges residents to check their voter registration and update their record before the Oct. 5 deadline. This is about registration upkeep, not ID or citizenship.
